payload.summary: 9 cowork agents reordered from 4-parallel-dump-streams to 1-chef + 4-gatherers + 2-event-only + 1-weekly. unified-agent becomes CHEF walking TNB 6-layer framework on 3 scheduled dishes/day. alert-commander narrowed to event-only. market-watcher and news-scout write signals only. cron table aligned to user timezone (France GMT+2) and VN market hours. 10 agent/flow files + 3 scheduler files change.

handoff.agent-father: Phases 1-3, 5-6: agent .md rewrites + flow rewrites. Start with unified-agent (T1) before narrowing alert-commander (T4 gated behind T1).
handoff.dev-mcp-server: Phase 4: foreignFlowAlertJob.ts 09:30 → 08:13 UTC; macroIndicatorRefreshJob.ts confirm 19:13 UTC slot; cronConfig.ts env-var defaults.
handoff.pm: Create sprint, sequence T1-T11, enforce T4 gate: alert-commander narrowing must not precede chef going live.
